changelog:
- Added per-user bridge mappings for multi-user setups
- Each Jellyfin user can now map to a different Hue bridge and entertainment area
- Users without mappings fall back to default bridge settings
- Improved API error handling and stability
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
